cases.query: what have I learned about choosing a vector database?

memories.content: Vector DB note: HNSW indexes give fast approximate nearest-neighbor search but use more memory than IVF. Good default for under ~10M vectors.
Vector DB note: managed services like Pinecone and Cloudflare Vectorize remove ops burden but cost more per query than self-hosting pgvector for small workloads.
Vector DB note: cosine similarity is the standard metric for text embeddings; normalize vectors first so dot product equals cosine.
